title: Users
description: Accounts, passwords, blocks and roles. Every change goes into the audit log.
syncHint: Fetch accounts created in the Keycloak console
synced: Sync: {seen} accounts in Keycloak, {created} new, {updated} changed.
loadFailed: The users could not be loaded.

roleHints.MEMBER: Notebook, wiki, the cooperative's chat. Every account has this role.
roleHints.ADMIN: Security console, AI models, users. Requires MFA.

lockout.lastAdmin: This is the last active administrator.

errors.user_exists: A user with this username or e-mail already exists.
errors.invalid_username: Username: 3–64 characters, lower-case letters, digits, dot, hyphen or underscore.
errors.email_required: An e-mail address is needed to send a link.
errors.profile_required: Enter the e-mail, first and last name (Keycloak requires them for every user).
errors.email_failed: The e-mail could not be sent (check e-mail in Keycloak). Choose a temporary password.
errors.password_policy: Keycloak rejected the generated password (password policy). Please try again.
errors.cannot_demote_self: You cannot remove your own administrator role.
errors.cannot_block_self: You cannot block your own account.
errors.last_admin: This is the last active administrator. Give the role to someone else first.
errors.external_identity: This account signs in through an external provider; that service manages the password.
errors.foreign_identity: This account comes from another identity provider.
errors.user_missing_in_idp: This account is not in Keycloak (deleted in the console?). Run a sync.
errors.user_admin_unavailable: User management is not configured (no Keycloak client). Server administrator: make keycloak-setup.
errors.idp_unavailable: Keycloak is temporarily unavailable. Please try again in a moment.
errors.rate_limited: Too many operations. Wait a moment.
errors.loadUser: The user could not be loaded.

panel.stepUp: Granting the expert or administrator role and unblocking an account need a fresh sign-in with a second factor.
panel.idpDown: Keycloak is unavailable: showing a saved copy of the data. Actions may fail.
panel.shieldLocked: The protection system locked the account: {reason}
panel.external: The account signs in through an external provider; the password is changed there.

rolesEditor.title: Roles
rolesEditor.granting: You are granting the role {roles} to {name}.
rolesEditor.mfaNext: At the next sign-in the user will set up an authenticator app (MFA).
rolesEditor.audited: The change will be recorded in the audit log.

blockDialog.title: Block the account?
blockDialog.body: {name} will not be able to sign in, and every open session ends at once. Content and authorship stay as they are.

unblockDialog.title: Unblock the account?
unblockDialog.body: {name} will be able to sign in again.
unblockDialog.shieldStays: The protection system's lock stays; you lift it separately, after reviewing the risk history.

resetDialog.title: Reset password
resetDialog.linkSent: We have sent a link to set a new password.
resetDialog.body: The current password will stop working, and {name} will be signed out of every device.

forceDialog.title: Require a password change?
forceDialog.body: At the next sign-in {name} must set a new password.
forceDialog.signOut: Sign out of every device now
forceDialog.done: A password change will be required at sign-in.

signOutDialog.title: Sign out of every device?
signOutDialog.body: All of {name}'s sessions will end at once. The account stays active.

create.done: Account created. We have sent a link to set the password.

create.mfaFirst: At the first sign-in the user will set up an authenticator app (MFA).
create.byEmail: A link by e-mail: the user sets the password
create.temporary: A temporary password: shown once, you hand it over in person
